text:
**Rowbase is out: turn a spreadsheet into an API in seconds**

As of March 4, 2026, anyone can use Rowbase. You give it a spreadsheet or data file and it gives you back a working REST API. You don't need a server or any backend code, and there's nothing to set up.

We built it because we kept running into the same problem. A team would have good data sitting in a file, and their app had no way to get at it. With Rowbase, you upload the file and get a live endpoint you can query right away. It reads five file formats, so your data probably doesn't need converting first.

Before launch, 212 beta users put Rowbase through its paces. Some built internal dashboards with it. Others used it for side projects or for prototypes their customers would see. A lot of what they told us went straight into the product. Setup got faster, the endpoints got cleaner, and there are fewer surprises than there used to be.

The free tier gives you 1,000 requests a day. That's enough for prototyping, a personal project, or a small app in production. If you outgrow it, there are paid plans that scale up with your usage.

To everyone who tested the beta: thank you. Rowbase wouldn't be where it is without you.

If you have a file with data you want to reach from an app, upload it to Rowbase and you'll have an API for it.
